# Outbreak Empire

> Outbreak Empire is a zombie survival strategy game for Android and iOS, in development by an independent developer based in Israel. It is free, with no in-app purchases at all: pure play to win. There is no release date yet; a closed test comes first, and players are invited from the waitlist.

Players build and grow a settlement in a ruined city, take in survivors and put them to work, hold their walls against zombie hordes, and defend against or attack other players on a live map. They can join or found a coalition and plan their wars together.

## Pages

- [Home](https://outbreakempire.com/): the game, the play to win promise, concept art, FAQ and the waitlist
- [Press kit](https://outbreakempire.com/press/): fact sheet, descriptions, logo and key art
- [Devlog](https://outbreakempire.com/devlog/): development notes
